replies.author: soulreaper2012
replies.body:
The song goes really well the the camera angles and the presentation of each scene. The short gameplay in between the intros of the over views of the maps and game modes was really neat. Demonstrates how the gameplay would be like. 

The ending was pretty neat with the blur. Created a foggy atmosphere for me since it had torches in that scene.

If I were to rate it outta 10, it would be around 9.7/10.

Very few issues. Although maybe it would've just maybe been better if you could have you or the camera rotating around the map (Full 360 Circle) in an High Angle shot, it would show the spawns and maybe a slight better presentation of how it looks and the dimensions.

Never the less keep this up :)
